# UX Requirements Checklist: Monitoring Configuration Final UX Adjustments

**Purpose**: Review clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability of the three UX adjustments
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the manual execution row action's configuration identity, pending behavior, and existing eligibility rules specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the existing success, concurrency-conflict, and safe-error outcomes covered for list-level manual execution? [Exception Flow, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the selected-scope sticky behavior and its boundaries relative to the tree, stepper, viewport, and fixed bottom bar specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification define narrow-layout behavior where the Scope columns stack? [Responsive Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are both create and edit final-save paths required to return to the configuration list only after success? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Are validation, policy, scope, schedule, and other finalization failures covered as no-redirect cases with recoverable input? [Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity and Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Is “successful final save” consistently defined as completion of the existing final Scheduling operation and any required save behavior? [Clarity, Spec §US3/FR-008–FR-010]
- [ ] CHK008 Is refreshing the list after a successful save described consistently with the existing list loading/cache conventions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the three UI changes clearly separated from prohibited changes to execution, scope, scheduling, and persistence semantics? [Scope, Spec §FR-012–FR-013]

## Acceptance and Edge-Case Quality

- [ ] CHK010 Can tests objectively identify that the row action targets only its own configuration and cannot issue duplicate concurrent requests? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK011 Can desktop sticky visibility and non-overlap with headings, stepper, and bottom navigation be objectively assessed? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Are partial-save and list-refresh failure outcomes specified without implying that a successful save can be undone? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
